verdict.rationale: Semgrep Secrets detects exposed credentials and validates them against the issuing web service, labeling as valid those confirmed to grant access [semgrep-docs-8, semgrep-docs-9]. It uses that validity to prioritize live secrets for security engineers and to flag valid secrets in PR/MR comments [semgrep-docs-43, semgrep-docs-10]. missing for 10: detail on which services/providers validators cover, how invalid or unverifiable results are reported, and independent or hands-on corroboration of validation accuracy.
